data.one_liner: Redis client for Dart with connection pooling, pub/sub, transactions, and pipelining.
data.what_it_does: Provides a fully-featured Redis client supporting strings, hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets, scripting, and pub/sub. Includes automatic pipelining, connection pooling, reconnection logic, and TLS support via URL configuration.
use_when: You need to connect a Dart or Flutter application directly to a Redis server
You require pub/sub messaging capabilities with binary or text payloads
You want automatic command pipelining and connection pooling
avoid_when: You need a local embedded key-value database specifically for local device storage without a running Redis server
Your application requires an offline-first NoSQL database like Hive or Isar
strengths: Supports pub/sub with both text and binary messages
Robust reconnection handling with retry strategies and handshake timeouts
Supports Redis URL configuration including TLS (rediss://)
weaknesses: Requires a running Redis server network connection
Not an embedded local storage solution
data.setup_notes: Requires a running Redis server instance (or multiple for test suites).
